title: Mouse with Lollipop Serpent
description: A brown mouse with a red bindi sits on a blue cube holding a large dripping yellow spiral lollipop. A colorful mosaic serpent coils around the mouse and a tree whose branches form a stained-glass cityscape against a dark background filled with floating smiley-face orbs.
prompt: A brown mouse with pink ears and a red bindi sits on a blue cube holding a large dripping yellow spiral lollipop on a stick. A vibrant mosaic serpent with intricate patterns coils around the mouse and the trunk of a tree. The tree branches transform into a colorful stained-glass city with blue and orange buildings. The background is dark with floating circular smiley faces in green, blue and yellow. A yellow brick road made of spiral patterns leads toward the mouse. Psychedelic folk art style with vibrant colors and detailed patterns.
